title: Remove intake manifold, throttle body, injectors and fuel rail

notices.text: Pull the fuel rail with the injectors attached, then press the injectors out. Every injector gets new upper and lower O-rings — they are hard as plastic at this age and they are a classic post-rebuild fuel-smell/rough-idle cause. Cover the head intake ports immediately. Inspect the intake ports for oil pooling: heavy oil in the intake is your AOS telling you it has failed.
